contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Soli Invicto Comiti issue of 310-319, Reece period 15. Obverse description: head laureate right. Obverse inscription: CONST[---]. Reverse description: Sol standing left holding globe. T in left field. Reverse inscription: SOLI INVICTO [COMITI]. Diameter: 19mm, Weight: 1.90gms, die axis: 6
